title: NASA DONKI: Solar Energetic Particle (SEP) Events & Radiation Protection Protocols
description: High-energy protons accelerated by solar flares and shocks. Operational protocols mandate checking mission-approved storm shelter procedures and monitoring real-time flux.
citation: NASA Space Radiation Analysis Group (SRAG) Operational Procedures

title: NASA DONKI: Solar Flares (FLR) Classification & Electromagnetic Effects
description: Classification of solar flares from GOES X-ray flux (C, M, X class). Provides situational space weather alerts without direct translation to absorbed personal dose.
citation: Community Coordinated Modeling Center (CCMC) DONKI API
